title: Front End Developer (React)
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Embrace Software is a fast-growing, founder-led company that acquires and grows mission-critical vertical-market software businesses across Industrial, Healthcare, Financial Services, and Education. Backed by $130M+ from tier-1 investors, we own companies serving Fortune 500s, governments, and hospitals across North America. The momentum is real: $130M raised, 0 to 450+ people in five years, an Inc. 5000 fastest-growing US company.​


Job Description


This is a remote position.


We’re looking for a React Front-End Developer to build clean, responsive, and performant user interfaces for modern web applications. You’ll work closely with designers, product managers, and backend engineers to translate product requirements into intuitive and reliable user experiences. This role involves building and maintaining production-ready front-end features using modern React-based architectures.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design, develop, and maintain high-quality UI components using React, TypeScript, and modern front-end tools
  • Integrate front-end components with RESTful APIs and backend services
  • Ensure responsive design, cross-browser compatibility, and strong UI performance
  • Participate in code reviews and technical discussions to maintain code quality and best practices
  • Contribute to a collaborative and learning-focused engineering culture
  • Build features that support real-world user and business workflows



Requirements
  • 3–4 years of professional experience building production front-end applications
  • Strong working knowledge of React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3
  • Experience with modern front-end tooling and build systems such as Vite, NPM, ESLint, and environment configuration
  • Solid understanding of component-based architecture and reusable UI development
  • Experience integrating React applications with REST APIs
  • Familiarity with state management solutions (Redux, Zustand, Context API, or similar)
  • Experience using component libraries or design systems (Material UI, Chakra UI, Ant Design, or similar)
  • Understanding of accessibility, responsive design principles, and cross-browser compatibility
  • Exposure to unit testing for React applications (Jest, React Testing Library, or similar)
  • Basic familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and front-end deployment workflows
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams
  • Self-driven, detail-oriented, and comfortable working in fast-paced environments
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
Nice to Have
  • Experience with debt collection or financial services software (huge plus)
  • Experience with TanStack Query or similar data-fetching libraries
  • Exposure to end-to-end testing tools (Playwright, Cypress, etc.)
  • Experience working in remote or distributed teams



Benefits
  • Competitive salary commensurate with experience.
  • Opportunities for career advancement and professional development.
  • ​Experience collaborating with a diverse, global team within a remote work setting.

title: Junior+ Frontend Developer
descriptionHtml:
Sumsub is a leading full-cycle verification platform that enables scalable compliance. From identity and business verification to ongoing monitoring, our platform adapts to different risk appetites and market demands, ensuring global compliance. It allows customizing analytics and workflows with a no-code interface.

Over 4,000 clients — including Bitpanda, Wirex, Avis, Bybit, Vodafone, Duolingo, Kaizen Gaming, and TransferGo — trust Sumsub to accelerate growth, prevent fraud, and maintain compliance worldwide.

Now we are looking for a Junior+ Frontend Developer to build and optimize the Sumsub global website and marketing interfaces. This role is an exciting opportunity to master a React 19 / Next.js 15 stack while shaping the visual identity of a leading global platform.

What You Will Be Doing:

  • UI Development: Building and maintaining high-performance landing pages and marketing components using React 19 and Next.js 15.
  • Visual Excellence: Implementing smooth animations and micro-interactions with Framer Motion and GSAP to ensure a premium user experience.
  • Content Integration: Connecting frontend components with Headless WordPress via GraphQL queries for seamless data delivery.
  • Code Quality & Growth: Participating in code reviews and a large-scale refactoring initiative to migrate from legacy code to a modern stack.
  • Performance Optimization: Monitoring and improving Core Web Vitals (LCP, CLS, INP) to keep the main website fast and SEO-friendly.


About You:

  • Foundation: 1+ year of commercial experience with React, Next.js, and TypeScript.
  • Modern Styling: Good grasp of CSS/SCSS, including Flexbox, Grid, and a basic understanding of fluid layouts (like clamp()).
  • Eye for Detail: A genuine interest in the visual side of frontend (animations, transitions) and a desire to build polished user interfaces.


What We Offer:

  • Remote-first, trust-based culture. Work from the place that works best for you. No mandatory office days, no attendance trackers. In some locations, we provide offices or coworking spaces, but the choice is yours.
  • True flexibility. We do not fix you to a 9-to-5 schedule. You can adjust your working hours when needed, as long as your day stays productive and in sync with the team.
  • Extra time off. Your birthday is a holiday here. Add to that 10 personal days each year, seven sick days without paperwork, and extra time to enjoy Christmas and New Year. Time to rest is part of the deal.
  • Work that matters. Our mission is to build a digital world that is secure, accessible and inclusive for everyone. From fighting fraud to making online services easier and safer to use, your work will have a real impact on how people experience trust online.
  • Compensation. We offer fair and transparent pay, benchmarked to the market.
  • Truly global. We work across continents and time zones, with teammates and customers from all over the world. You will run campaigns that cross borders, cultures, and languages, and see your ideas land worldwide.
  • Growth built in. Clear goals, open feedback and personal development plans. We support your progress with learning opportunities and by covering role-specific events, from design conferences to marketing forums.
  • Team offsites. Sometimes just Slack is not enough. That is why we meet in person a few times a year. Trips are fully covered, so you can meet, collaborate, and recharge together.
  • Getting you set up. We make sure you have access to the tools and hardware you need to do your work well.
  • Friendly by design. Our logo is a dog for a reason. We keep things human, open and kind. We welcome individuality, quirks and different perspectives, because that is what makes our work smarter and more fun.


The hiring stages: TA screening -> Hiring Manager Interview -> Final Interview.

Sounds like a great opportunity for your career development? Then go ahead and apply!

We are a global community of innovators, creators, and thinkers, and we believe that diversity fuels our innovation. Sumsub is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, cultures, genders, experiences, abilities and perspectives. Join us in shaping the future inclusively.

title: Frontend Developer Fresher
descriptionHtml:
Primary title: Front-end Developer Fresher

This fully remote role welcomes engineers who ship production-quality UI, optimise for performance and accessibility, and collaborate cross-functionally to deliver measurable product outcomes.

Role & Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain responsive user interfaces using component-driven React architecture.
  • Translate UX designs into pixel-perfect, accessible pages while ensuring cross-browser compatibility and WCAG best practices.
  • Integrate front-end components with backend services and REST APIs to deliver robust, data-driven features.
  • Improve application performance through code-splitting, lazy loading, bundle optimisations, and runtime profiling.
  • Author unit and E2E tests, participate in code reviews, and follow CI/CD pipelines to ensure reliable releases.
  • Collaborate with product, design, and backend teams to define technical solutions and mentor junior engineers.

Skills & Qualifications

Must-Have

  • JavaScript
  • React
  • TypeScript
  • HTML5
  • CSS3
  • REST APIs

Preferred

  • Redux
  • Next.js
  • Jest

Benefits & Culture Highlights

  • Fully remote work with flexible hours and India-based hiring.
  • Strong engineering culture: mentorship, code quality practices, and ownership of deliverables.
  • Opportunities to work on high-impact features used by enterprise customers and grow into senior roles.

title: Front end developer
descriptionHtml:
hackajob is collaborating with Version 1 to connect them with exceptional professionals for this role.

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Senior Frontend Developer to join our UK Digital & Cloud Practice. Our Digital Practice is expanding rapidly and there will be an opportunity for you to achieve medium and long-term career goals. As well as fantastic growth opportunities there is the opportunity to work on some really challenging and interesting, large scale transformational and migration projects within both public and private sector.

As a Senior Front End Developer, you'll collaborate closely with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Technical Architects, UX/UI Designers and other team members to understand business requirements and drive the solution design and development of our digital products. Your role involves ensuring that the code aligns with these requirements and adheres to our architectural and front-end coding standards. Performance optimisation is key, and you'll employ best practices to enhance our applications. Additionally, you'll stay proactive by suggesting upgrades and updates to maintain modern security standards and adhere to evolving best practices in development. Your contributions extend beyond individual projects; you'll help enrich our shared component libraries by crafting modular and reusable components. Furthermore, as a valued member of our team, you'll provide mentorship to junior members and actively share your expertise across the wider team.

  • Work collaboratively with product owners, business analysts, technical architects, UX/UI designers, and other team members to understand business requirements and drive the solution design and development of our digital products.
  • Ensure code meets the requirements and is in accordance with our architectural and front-end coding standards and patterns.
  • Optimising applications using best practices for performance.
  • Propose any upgrades and updates necessary for keeping up with modern security and the development of best practices.
  • Contribute to our shared component libraries and build modular and reusable components and libraries.
  • Provide mentorship for more junior members of the team and share knowledge of your skillsets out to the wider team

This role involves working for government clients so all candidates need to either hold SC Clearance or be SC Eligible

Qualifications

  • You will have an extensive background in front-end development with significant experience working with React
  • Experience in Redux or Zustand
  • Experience in React Query
  • Experienced with Jest for Unit Testing
  • Experience in Node.js
  • Experience with TypeScript desirable
  • Experience with Nest.js or Express.js desirable
  • Should be able to demonstrate a strong core front-end skillset of HTML 5, CSS 3, JavaScript
  • Appetite to work with emerging AI technologies
  • SC Eligible

descriptionHtml:
About MaxIQ

MaxIQ empowers Go-To-Market teams to ascend to new heights in their sales performance, unlocking boundless opportunities for growth. We're passionate about helping sales teams excel beyond expectations. Our pride lies in assembling an unparalleled team and crafting a crucial solution that becomes an indispensable tool for our users. With MaxIQ, sales excellence becomes an attainable reality.

About The Job

MaxIQ is looking for an experienced React JS Developer to join our dynamic team! As a React JS Developer, you will be responsible for building responsive and scalable applications using React JS and associated tooling (Redux, Jest, Cypress & BuildPacks).

Must-Have Skills

  • 3+ years of production experience with React JS and associated tooling (Redux & Unit Testing)
  • 1+ years of Typescript experience, including asynchronous programming, closures, types, and ES6/ES7.
  • Thorough understanding of React.js and its core principles, including virtual DOM, data binding, State & Props and React Lifecycle and Redux.
  • Good Experience with HTML, CSS3/JSS & Material UI, etc.
  • Knowledge of cross-browser compatibilities, responsiveness, and web accessibility standards.
  • Strong understanding of software engineering best practices, including unit testing, code reviews, design documentation, debugging, troubleshooting, and agile development.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience.

If you are passionate about React JS development and have the required qualifications, we want to hear from you! You must be an excellent verbal and written communicator, enjoy collaborating with others, and welcome discussing a plan upfront. We offer a competitive salary, flexible work hours, and a dynamic work environment.

Apply now and join our team of skilled professionals!
